notes:
v4.6.47 — Cloud IBKR bots no longer need your local TWS open

🐛 FIXED — 'Run on Oracle' IBKR bots refused to start unless TWS was open
• When you pressed ▶ on an IBKR bot set to run on the cloud, the app first ran a LOCAL check that tried to reach TWS/IB Gateway on your own computer (127.0.0.1) — and blocked the bot if it couldn't. Opening TWS 'fixed' it, which is exactly backwards for a cloud bot.
• Now, a bot set to 'Run on Oracle' goes straight to the cloud path and skips all local-machine checks (local gateway probe, local key check, bundled-package check). The Oracle server runs its own IB Gateway and validates its own credentials.
• Result: your IBKR bots start and trade on the cloud with TWS CLOSED and your laptop OFF — no local connection required.

Note: the 'Test connection' button in Tools → IBKR only ever tests your LOCAL TWS/Gateway; it's not used for cloud bots and will say 'could not reach' when TWS is closed even though cloud trading works fine.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
